preregistered_net_rule: Monthly, 5 bp, next open, every integer M,N from 1 to 52 inclusive, N expressed equivalently as X=N/52. Maximize 2021-2024 annualized net Sharpe. Round Sharpe to 12 decimals for ties, then prefer N closest to scaled 15, M closest to incumbent 6, smaller M then smaller N. Identical IS weight paths may share one exact app replay. Report tie count, near-optima, yearly prefix winners, return and drawdown guards. No return floor or cost veto.
